newsitem.title: UK: TENNIS-MIXED DOUBLES RESULTS AT WIMBLEDON.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-MIXED DOUBLES RESULTS AT WIMBLEDON.

text.p: Mixed doubles results at Wimbledon on Saturday (prefix denotes seeding):
John-Laffnie De Jager (South Africa)/Martina Hingis (Switzerland) beat Karsten Braasch/Barbara Rittner (Germany) 6-4 6-3
4-Cyril Suk/Helena Sukova (Czech Republic) beat Tom Nijssen (Netherlands)/Yayuk Basuki (Indonesia) 6-1 0-6 6-4
Neil Broad (Britain)/Mariaan De Swardt (South Africa) beat John-Laffnie De Jager (South Africa)/Martina Hingis (Switzerland) 5-7 6-3 6-4
